REQ-007's refusals then fail for AEN-004, 005, 010 and the v1 cases 003, 004, 011; AEN-011 (empty clip) still refused; AEN-032 opens either way
spec_findings.SF-4: r4 AEN-033 is set on T0 (the v1 case-010 fixture), which the structural rules refuse (no freeze sequencer); v2 case 032 adds the T11 lines
spec_findings.SF-5: r4 'Released automation-envelopes-v1 is not contradicted' no longer holds (T11 audit; SF-3)
